results.title: Bunny
results.overview: Two best friends rally the neighbors in their tenement building to help them hide a dead body over the best/worst night of their lives.

results.title: Husk
results.overview: As the undead close in on their shelter, three survivors face a moral dilemma when one is bitten, forcing them to choose between survival or their fleeting humanity.

results.title: Silent Shot
results.overview: Alex is a dazzling young French EDM artist who’s in Japan to shoot music videos for her new album. During the shooting, she gets close to her pretty Japanese assistant Mia. The burgeoning love story is suddenly stopped when the director decides to shoot Mia instead of her. As jealousy settles stronger and stronger, little by little Alex falls into paranoid madness…

results.title: Grace For Sale
results.overview: From the heavens, meteors shower upon a humble Anatolian village. In this celestial display, a simple-minded peasant unexpectedly finds the largest of these stones, now sought after for substantial sums. An unimaginable opportunity graces him —a man with nothing to lose yet lacking nothing. Carried away with invasive dreams, the Americans +10$ promise haunts him. His journey to sell this precious object at a higher rate propels him into a realm of power and greed, exposing him to deprivation of things he never harbored. As he keeps wanting a little more, he starts to lose what he already has.

results.title: Goodbye, My Friend
results.overview: At 35, Étienne still hasn't forgiven his 'friend' Jean-Pat, who made his life miserable throughout his childhood. When he learns of Jean-Pat's death, Étienne isn't exactly devastated... Yet, despite himself, he finds himself organising the funeral of his worst enemy. One thing is certain: Jean-Pat isn't done ruining his life yet.

results.title: 10 Minutes
results.overview: 10 Minutes is a short film about grief, memory, and the fragile shape of time.  Troy begins what should be the brightest day of his career, but everything shifts when he learns his mother is in critical condition. As he races home, a fallen hourglass from his childhood pulls him into the memories and advice she left behind, reminding him to breathe and stay true to himself when life becomes overwhelming.  Through loss, family, and quiet reflection, Troy discovers how quickly a single moment can alter a life and how the smallest memories can carry the most weight. 10 Minutes captures the painful and beautiful truth that time can slip away, yet still leave echoes that stay with us.

results.title: Revelations
results.overview: Two married surgeons navigate a series of revelations about their partners past life.

results.title: 13 novembre, nos vies en éclats
results.overview: On November 13, 2015, the attacks in Paris and Saint-Denis, carried out by three Islamist commandos and claimed by ISIS, were the deadliest in France since the end of World War II. In the months that followed, the November 13 Program was launched by the CNRS and Inserm to study the construction of individual and collective memory around an event that profoundly marked French society. Today, the testimonies of 27 volunteers—among some 1,000 people—who participated in the study form a mosaic of experiences that shows how trauma extends beyond the immediate circle to permeate the national collective memory.

results.title: Di'Anno: Iron Maiden's Lost Singer
results.overview: Paul Di'Anno (Paul Andrews), Iron Maiden's first vocalist before Bruce Dickinson, passed away in October 2024. Di'Anno was expelled from the band after the release of their second album due to drug and alcohol problems. During this period, he signed a contract excluding him from song royalties after Iron Maiden had risen to fame. "Di'Anno: Iron Maiden's Lost Singer" follows Paul Di'Anno's final years.

results.title: Blood Brothers: Life Harvest
results.overview: Brothers Enoch and Aaron fight to protect their family as a deadly rabies like virus spreads across the world. When one of them is bitten by a zombie, they must ask themselves the ultimate question: Is blood thicker than water?

results.title: Rumpelstiltskin
results.overview: Once upon a time, a miller attempted to marry his daughter off to the King by promising she could spin straw into gold. With the help of a demonic imp, she completes the task, but the King becomes greedy and wants more. So, she promises the imp her firstborn in return for yet more favours. But when it comes time to honour her bargain, dark forces merge when the Imp makes a deal with the devil.

results.title: Chronicles of Sonatine or: Shadows of the Broken Memories
results.original_title: Chronicles of Sonatine or: Shadows of the Broken Memories
results.overview: After the disappearance of a young actress, a director is left alone with memories, guilt, and the silence she left behind. In an attempt to understand what happened, he confronts himself, the past, and an unknown figure who seems to have always been there. Chronicles of Sonatine or: Shadows of the Broken Memories is a story built on half-truths and the people who get lost within them. Can you restore a memory… without distorting it?

results.title: A Day
results.overview: A young boxer must confront his family's traumatic past when his estranged older brother is released from prison.

results.title: Wedding in Hundsling
results.overview: There are two inns in the village of Hundsling, one too many. When Magdalena arrives for her mother's funeral, she sees how overwhelmed her father Xaver is with the family business, the “Rosi” inn. She decides to save it from ruin. In order to eliminate the competition, the “Casa Toni”, she resorts to quite unfair means. A fierce dispute divides the entire village.

results.title: Vine Harvest
results.overview: Years after leaving his family and past behind, Burak returns to his birthplace following a long, troubled life in Istanbul. Among Bozcaada’s vineyards, he confronts unfinished business, broken relationships, and buried secrets. Shadows from his family’s past push him into an inner reckoning and an irreversible journey. Amid nature’s conflicts and society’s dead ends, Burak searches for a new meaning in life and for himself.

results.title: Night of Wrath
results.overview: A group of seemingly virtuous leaders are trapped in a haunted house by a madmen threatening to ruin their lives by revealing their darkest secrets.

results.title: Pumpkin
results.overview: A young woman embarks on a journey of finding her one true love within the modern dating world.

results.title: Death Before the Wedding
results.overview: When Maja brings her fiancé home, her traditional parents must overcome their cultural biases amidst a crisis at their dairy farm. Can love find a way?

results.title: One Year and One Day
results.overview: Hugo has lost the love of his life and he intends to get her back by learning to play the piano for a year. Nerea, his neighbor, will be the one to help him achieve it by giving piano lessons.

results.title: Between Days
results.overview: Between Days follows the Arc'teryx snow team in the Japanese Alps during a season-defining storm cycle. Nine riders from four countries, united by a shared language of storm riding.  What happens when nine snowboarders from four countries arrive in Japan’s Alps in the middle of a season defining storm cycle? The universal language of “dig yourself out, ride until your legs give in, then do it all again” dissolves all barriers — forging a quiet bond through the raw experience of storm riding. Guided by snowboarding legend Tadashi Fuse, the crew dives into hip-deep powder turns and Japanese philosophical reflections found in the highs and lows of the mountains.  This is a snowboard film like no other — familiar yet entirely new. With a stellar athlete line-up, shot in stunning black-and-white on 16mm, featuring Sherpas Cinema–certified cameramen, and produced by Robyn van Gyn and legend Shin Campus, it’s blessed with some of the most unreal powder imaginable.
